mintAuthority.summary: USDat is an M0-backed extension on Ethereum; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDat depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: SwapFacility is reviewed as the same ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController governance pattern as verified MUSD.

controls.label: USDat proxy admin timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25570046 (2026-07-20): EIP-1967 slots on the USDat proxy 0x23238f20b894f29041f48d88ee91131c395aaa71 read implementation 0x17cac25c6d6bbcb592837fea083a5c8eb4d1e52e and admin 0xcf1072da5f0d127aef99136489bad08bfa3d1a7d; the ProxyAdmin's owner() is TimelockController 0xfd5782e3bff366601da3973ae30c583de4f08a67 with getMinDelay() = 432,000 seconds (5 days).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable non-proxy (IsProxy=false, both EIP-1967 slots zero). SwapFacility confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy; ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5... → TimelockController 0x23ca665c... (3-day minDelay); timelock proposer is Gnosis Safe 3/5. Same governance structure as verified musd-metamask. All controls fully characterized. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: M0 TTG governance controls base-M capacity while SwapFacility and USDat logic changes pass through enforced three- and five-day timelocks; real-time M0 validator/reserve reconciliation exists without named prudential supervision.
